name: Major cyber incidents
summary: US FinCEN takes systems offline after unauthorised access, confirmed 25 Nov; Colorado state app downed by attack
state: The US Treasury's FinCEN took some systems offline after confirming unauthorised access to part of its network, giving no date for full service on 25 Nov; its BSA e-filing site stayed up (Cyber Security News). On 24 Nov Colorado said a cyberattack took down the myColorado app and that data on 150,000 people was stolen, and CISA warned of an exploited N-able flaw (The Record). Disruption to public services keeps Watch; no national-scale attack on critical infrastructure was found.
for_you: Be alert to phishing that exploits news of breaches. Follow NCSC guidance on reporting scams and securing accounts.
rubric_hit: Attack disrupting a critical service (FinCEN, Colorado app) = Watch; not national-scale

sources.title: Cyber Security News — FinCEN confirms cyberattack, takes systems offline

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
